nodes.label: index.html (NutriScan web app)
nodes.rationale: Single-file app: HTML + CSS + JS in one page, wrapped by Capacitor into the Android APK.

nodes.label: fetchProduct()
nodes.rationale: If the barcode is not found in the database for the current mode, it retries the other database and flips the mode, so a cosmetic scanned in food mode still resolves.

nodes.label: html5QrCode scanner (html5-qrcode 2.3.8)
nodes.rationale: Camera access goes through html5-qrcode in the WebView (getUserMedia), loaded from unpkg.

nodes.label: APK build via GitHub Actions
nodes.rationale: Recommended path: no local tooling needed, push to GitHub and download the APK from Releases or Actions artifacts.

nodes.label: COSMETIC_INGREDIENTS (INCI regex rules)
nodes.rationale: 22 regex rules for endocrine disruptors, allergens, irritants and controversial ingredients.

nodes.label: FOOD_ADDITIVES (E-number risk table)
nodes.rationale: 74 E-numbers, each with risk level 1-4, category, reason and a cited source.

nodes.label: FOOD_KEYWORDS (ingredient-text rules)
nodes.rationale: Regex rules on the ingredient text for palm oil, hydrogenated oils and glucose/fructose syrups.

nodes.label: 100-point health score
nodes.rationale: Start at 100; subtract 20/12/5 per level-4/3/2 finding; extra penalties for sugar, salt, saturated fat and calories; Nutri-Score adjusts +10..-20; clamp to 0-100.

nodes.label: NutriScan Android app
nodes.rationale: Described as a food barcode scanner; the README does not mention the cosmetics mode (Open Beauty Facts) that the app now has.
